SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS store_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fwo.web_order_id) AS web_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.channel_code = 'ST' THEN fsl.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS store_sales_gross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.channel_code = 'WB' THEN fsl.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS web_sales_gross
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON d.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON d.calendar_date = fwo.order_ts_utc::date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS store_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fwo.web_order_id) AS web_orders,
  MIN(fsl.sale_date) AS first_store_sale_date,
  MAX(fsl.sale_date) AS last_store_sale_date,
  MIN(fwo.order_ts_utc::date) AS first_web_order_date,
  MAX(fwo.order_ts_utc::date) AS last_web_order_date
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON d.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON d.calendar_date = fwo.order_ts_utc::date
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year

WITH period_dates AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
),
store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    pd.fiscal_year,
    pd.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS num_receipts,
    SUM(fsl.gross_amount) AS total_gross
  FROM period_dates pd
  JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON fsl.sale_date BETWEEN pd.period_start_date AND pd.period_end_date
    AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY pd.fiscal_year, pd.fiscal_period
),
web_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    pd.fiscal_year,
    pd.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fwo.web_order_id) AS num_orders,
    SUM(fwo.order_total_gross) AS total_gross
  FROM period_dates pd
  JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fwo.order_ts_utc::date BETWEEN pd.period_start_date AND pd.period_end_date
  GROUP BY pd.fiscal_year, pd.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(ss.fiscal_year, wo.fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year,
  COALESCE(ss.fiscal_period, wo.fiscal_period) AS fiscal_period,
  COALESCE(ss.num_receipts, 0) AS store_receipts,
  COALESCE(wo.num_orders, 0) AS web_orders,
  COALESCE(ss.total_gross, 0) + COALESCE(wo.total_gross, 0) AS total_transaction_value,
  COALESCE(ss.num_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(wo.num_orders, 0) AS total_transactions,
  (COALESCE(ss.total_gross, 0) + COALESCE(wo.total_gross, 0)) / (COALESCE(ss.num_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(wo.num_orders, 0)) AS atv
FROM store_sales ss
FULL OUTER JOIN web_orders wo ON ss.fiscal_period = wo.fiscal_period
ORDER BY COALESCE(ss.fiscal_period, wo.fiscal_period)

  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar

),
store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    pd.fiscal_year,
    pd.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS num_receipts,
    SUM(fsl.gross_amount) AS total_gross
  FROM period_dates pd
  JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON fsl.sale_date BETWEEN pd.period_start_date AND pd.period_end_date
    AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY pd.fiscal_year, pd.fiscal_period
),
web_orders AS (

SELECT 
  COALESCE(ss.fiscal_year, wo.fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year,
  COALESCE(ss.fiscal_period, wo.fiscal_period) AS fiscal_period,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ss.num_receipts, 0)::NUMERIC, 0) AS store_receipts,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wo.num_orders, 0)::NUMERIC, 0) AS web_orders,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ss.total_gross, 0) + COALESCE(wo.total_gross, 0), 2) AS total_transaction_value,
  ROUND((COALESCE(ss.total_gross, 0) + COALESCE(wo.total_gross, 0)) / (COALESCE(ss.num_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(wo.num_orders, 0)), 2) AS atv
FROM store_sales ss
FULL OUTER JOIN web_orders wo ON ss.fiscal_period = wo.fiscal_period
ORDER BY COALESCE(ss.fiscal_period, wo.fiscal_period)

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  fsl.channel_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as num_receipts,
  SUM(fsl.gross_amount) as total_gross
FROM dim_date d
JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON d.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, fsl.channel_code

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as fsl_web_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fwo.web_order_id) as fwo_orders,
  SUM(fsl.gross_amount) as fsl_web_gross,
  SUM(fwo.order_total_gross) as fwo_gross
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON d.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date AND fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON d.calendar_date = fwo.order_ts_utc::date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as fsl_wb_receipt_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fwo.web_order_id) as fwo_web_order_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id THEN fsl.receipt_id END) as matching_ids
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
CROSS JOIN fact_web_order fwo
WHERE fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND fsl.sale_date = fwo.order_ts_utc::date
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2025-04-28' AND fsl.sale_date <= '2025-07-27'

WITH period_sales AS (
  -- Store sales by period
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    'Store' as channel,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS num_transactions,
    COALESCE(SUM(fsl.gross_amount), 0) AS total_value
  FROM dim_date d
  LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON d.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date AND fsl.channel_code = 'ST'
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Web orders by period
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    'Web' as channel,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fwo.web_order_id) AS num_transactions,
    COALESCE(SUM(fwo.order_total_gross), 0) AS total_value
  FROM dim_date d
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON d.calendar_date = fwo.order_ts_utc::date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'Store' THEN num_transactions ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC, 0) as store_receipts,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'Web' THEN num_transactions ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC, 0) as web_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(total_value), 2) as combined_value,
  ROUND(SUM(num_transactions)::NUMERIC, 0) as total_transactions,
  ROUND(SUM(total_value) / SUM(num_transactions), 2) as atv
FROM period_sales
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period

store_sales AS (

    pd.fiscal_year,

SELECT 
  ss.fiscal_year,
  ss.fiscal_period,
  ss.num_receipts AS store_receipts,
  wo.num_orders AS web_orders,
  ss.num_receipts + wo.num_orders AS total_transactions,
  ROUND(ss.total_gross + wo.total_gross, 2) AS transaction_value_eur,

FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN web_orders wo ON ss.fiscal_period = wo.fiscal_period
ORDER BY ss.fiscal_period
